title: First-Principles Thinking
hook: Half the rules you run your business by, you picked up from someone else and never checked.
statement: Break problems down to what's actually true, then rebuild from there.
explainer: 'That's how it's done' isn't a reason. Strip a problem down to verified facts and you often find a cheaper, faster way nobody else bothered to look for.
sop: Pick one rule you operate by and write down where it came from.
Score your Truth and Inherited Assumptions 1 to 10.
Strip the situation down to what you can verify.
Rebuild your approach only from those facts.
Test the new way small before switching fully.
equation_example: Truth, what you've verified yourself, is 8. Inherited Assumptions is 6. 8 ÷ 6 = 1.3. Above 1 means you're mostly working from tested facts. Below 1 means you're building on borrowed beliefs.
question: Write down one business 'rule' you follow and where you actually got it from.
closing_statement: Question the assumption before you accept the conclusion.
caption:
